parsedContent.subject: Chemistry
parsedContent.keyUnitCompetence: Assess the applications of chemistry in daily life and explain its contribution to Rwanda’s economy.
parsedContent.lessonTitle: Definition, Importance and Applications of Chemistry
parsedContent.instructionalObjectives: By using the textbook and real product samples, Senior 1 learners who attend will be able to define chemistry, explain its importance and cite at least two everyday applications clearly at more than 8/10 within 40 min.
parsedContent.learningMaterials: Chemistry Senior One textbook, real product samples (soap, fertilizer, metal tool), chart paper, markers, learner notebook
parsedContent.references:
Rwanda Education Board. (2025). Chemistry Senior One Student Book. Kigali: REB.
Foreword, Chemistry Senior One textbook.
parsedContent.lessonOverview: *Learners explore the role of chemistry in everyday life through discussion and real examples.*

steps.name: Introduction
teacherActivities: Displays real product samples and asks: What do you think created these items?
learnerActivities: Observes samples and shares ideas in pairs.
competences: Communication: Expressing ideas about everyday objects using scientific language.

steps.name: Lesson Development
teacherActivities: Facilitates group discussion on definition of chemistry using dictionary and textbook.
Guides learners to list importance of chemistry from textbook and examples.
Leads investigation where groups match each product sample to a chemical process taught in class.
Summarises key points on chart paper.
learnerActivities: Research definition in dictionary or internet.
Discusses importance in groups and records points.
Identifies chemical processes behind each sample and presents findings.
Listens to summary and adds notes.
competences: Critical thinking: Analysing everyday products to uncover chemical principles.
Research and problem solving: Using resources to construct a definition and link applications.

steps.name: Conclusion
teacherActivities: Assigns homework to write a short paragraph describing a household item and the chemistry involved.
competences: Lifelong learning: Reflecting on lesson content and planning independent inquiry.
